…半个小时不到，宋有蔓就赶到了医院。病房的门还没推开，夏晚安就听到了宋有蔓扯着嗓子喊“安安”的声音。门被大力的推开，又被大力的关上，宋有蔓就像是修仙的高手一般，只是一眨眼的功夫就到了夏晚安的身边：“安安，你到底伤在了哪里？”“安安，好端端的，你怎么突然就受伤了呢？”“安安……”趴在床上，行动不便的夏晚安，在宋有蔓伸出手摸自己额头的时候，总算看了她一眼，然后她险些没被宋有蔓此时此刻的造型惊到：“蔓蔓，你怎么这样就跑过来了？”宋有蔓的脸上，贴着面膜，脑袋上顶着卷发棒，身上还穿着理发店的衣服……“你还说，我接到你的电话，都吓死了好吗？还好还好伤的没有那么严重……”宋有蔓边说，边去检查夏晚安的后背：“……说不严重，也挺严重的呀，这么一大片，都紫了……你怎么就能把自己给砸伤呀……”夏晚安没说话，但心底却蓦的一暖，然后再联想到刚刚给韩经年打电话时，自己的丈夫，原本应该是这个世界上最亲密的人，对自己那样疏离淡漠的态度，她的眼底一酸，险些就这么落了泪。宋有蔓察觉到夏晚安的不对劲，将脸伸到了夏晚安的面前，盯着她看了会儿，然后想都不用想，就开口说：“你给他打电话了？”这个世界上，能让夏晚安难过的，就只有那一个人。夏晚安“嗯”了一声。“你给他打电话了，他都没来医院看你？！”宋有蔓瞬间炸毛：“我，我，我这个暴脾气哦，真想弄死他个拔吊无情的人！”“我没告诉他，我受伤了……”“哦哦哦，原来他不知道啊，那我撤回我刚刚说的话……”宋有蔓瞬间消气，三秒后，她瞪向了夏晚安：“你为什么不告诉他？你受伤了，怎么就不能告诉他了？p，说来说去，他还是个拔吊无情的人！他丫的，提了裤子不认账，他以为家里的老婆是什么呀，是摆设吗？想起来，回去睡一炮，想不起来，就冷处理？他丫的跟嫖客有个毛线的区别……”越说越没边了……夏晚安：“宋小姐！”“好吧，对不起，我不该那样说的，应该是，你跟嫖-客一样，想起来去嫖一嫖他！反正一无是处的他，长得还挺养眼的，你就当搞个小白脸，等到把他玩腻了，我们就把他踹了，哈哈哈……”听着宋有蔓的话，夏晚安哭笑不得。她在脑海里，脑补了一下自己嫖韩经年的场景，以及他是她包养的小白脸的画面，忍不住噗嗤的笑了……看到她笑了，宋有蔓也跟着笑了，“好了，笑了就好，我先去把头发和脸洗了，你等我哈。”说着，宋有蔓飘进了病房的洗手间。听着里面传出来的哗啦哗啦的流水声，夏晚安心底更暖了，蔓蔓总是这样，在她最难过的时候，总是有方式缓和她的难过……

…Song Youman arrived at the hospital in less than half an hour. Before the door of the ward was opened, Xia Wan'an heard Song Youman shouting "An'an" at the top of her lungs. The door was pushed open and closed with great force. Song Youman was like a master of cultivating immortals. In just a blink of an eye, he was at Xia Wan'an's side: "An An, where are you injured?" "An An, everything is fine, why are you injured suddenly?" "An An..." Lying on the bed , Good night to Xia, who had difficulty moving. When Song Youman stretched out her hand to touch her forehead, she finally took a look at her. Then she was almost not surprised by Song Youman's appearance at this moment: "Manman, why did you come here like this?" Song Youman had a mask on his face, a curling iron on his head, and a hair stick on his body. Wearing clothes from a barber shop... "You also said that when I received your call, I was scared to death, okay? Fortunately, the injury was not that serious..." Song Youman said, while going to check Xia Wan'an's back: "... It's not serious, but it is quite serious. Such a large area is purple... How can you do that? You hurt yourself..." Xia Wan'an didn't say anything, but her heart suddenly felt warm. Then she thought about how her husband, who was supposed to be the closest person in the world, had such a distant and indifferent attitude towards her when she called Han Jingnian just now. Her eyes became sour and she almost shed tears. Song Youman noticed something was wrong with Xia Wan'an, put his face in front of Xia Wan'an, stared at her for a while, and then said without thinking, "Did you call him?" In this world, there was only one person who could make Xia Wan'an sad. Xia Wan'an said "hmm". "You called him, but he didn't even come to the hospital to see you?!" Song Youman instantly exploded: "I, I, I have such a bad temper, I really want to kill him for being such a ruthless person!" "I didn't tell him, I was injured..." "Oh oh oh, it turns out he doesn't know, then I'll withdraw. Reply to what I just said..." Song Youman lost her temper for a moment, and after three seconds, she glared at Xia Wan'an: "Why didn't you tell him? Why couldn't you tell him that you were injured? p, after all, he is still a ruthless person! Do you think the wife at home is just a decoration? If you think about it, go back and have sex, and then treat her coldly if you can’t remember her? The more you talk about it, the more confused you are... Good night Xia: "Ms. Song!" "Okay, I shouldn't have said that. , it should be that you are like a prostitute, you want to go whore with him! Anyway, he is good for nothing, but he is quite attractive, so you just treat him like a pretty boy, and when we get tired of playing with him, we will kick him, hahaha..." Listening to Song Youman's words, Xia Wan'an couldn't laugh or cry. In her mind, she imagined the scene of her whoring with Han Jingnian, and the scene of him being the pretty boy she kept, and she couldn't help but laugh... Seeing her smile, Song Youman also laughed, "Okay, just laugh. I'll wash my hair and face first. Just wait for me." With that, Song Youman floated into the bathroom of the ward. Listening to the sound of running water coming from inside, Xia Wan's heart felt even warmer. Manman was always like this. When she was most sad, she always found a way to ease her sadness...
